definition.en: The crust and rigid uppermost mantle.
definition.zh: 地壳与上地幔最上部的刚性部分。

definition.en: A moving part of the lithosphere that may carry land and ocean floor.
definition.zh: 岩石圈中相对运动的一块，可以同时承载陆地与海底。

definition.en: A region where neighbouring plates move relative to one another.
definition.zh: 相邻板块发生相对运动的地区。

definition.en: Oceanic lithosphere descends beneath another plate.
definition.zh: 大洋岩石圈沉入另一板块下方的过程。

definition.en: Plates mainly slide horizontally past each other.
definition.zh: 板块主要沿水平方向彼此错动的边界。

definition.en: A fracture along which rock moves; sudden slip can generate an earthquake.
definition.zh: 岩石沿其发生位移的破裂面；突然滑动可引发地震。

definition.en: The surface point above where earthquake rupture begins.
definition.zh: 地震破裂开始位置正上方的地表点。

definition.en: A measure of earthquake size, distinct from local shaking.
definition.zh: 衡量地震规模的量，与某地摇晃强弱不同。

definition.en: Shaking or effects at a particular place.
definition.zh: 某一地点受到的摇晃或影响程度。

definition.en: A series of long waves caused by sudden water displacement.
definition.zh: 海水突然位移引起的一系列长波。

definition.en: The maximum height reached onshore above sea level.
definition.zh: 海水到达岸上、相对海平面的最大高度。

definition.en: A large volcanic collapse depression, distinct from an ordinary summit crater.
definition.zh: 火山塌陷形成的较大洼地，不同于普通山顶火山口。

definition.en: A catalogue of volcanoes in the Holocene scope, not a list of volcanoes erupting today.
definition.zh: 按全新世范围收录的火山资料，不是今天正在喷发的名单。

definition.en: A popular name whose geographical scope varies between sources.
definition.zh: 一个通俗地区名称，不同资料对它的地理范围定义不同。
